title: Reading Level
description: Prevents writing that's too hard for its readers with a live Flesch-Kincaid grade against a target, the hardest sentences tinted in place (only when long and dense, so plain long sentences aren't nagged) with the reason and a jump to each, and one-tap plain-word swaps ("utilize" → "use", "in the event that" → "if").
stops: Copy too hard for its readers
